ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white cauliflower-like florets, clustered in a loose group of about 6-8 small heads, each 2-3 cm across, dry matte surface with slightly textured bumpy tops, sitting on the upper-left of the plate near the apple | 75
ITEM 2 | Whole apple, roughly 7-8 cm diameter, glossy red skin with yellow-green patches and a small stem dimple on top, firm and intact, sitting on the left-center of the plate | 180
ITEM 3 | Whole almonds, roughly 20-25 pieces, smooth tan-brown shells with pointed tips, dry matte surface, scattered in a loose cluster in the upper-right area of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Orange melon pieces, about 8 wedge-shaped chunks each roughly 3-4 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, smooth peeled-looking surface with slight sheen, firm and moist-looking edges, arranged in a fan on the right of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Cherry tomatoes, 5 small round whole tomatoes about 2-2.5 cm diameter, glossy bright red skin with slight sheen, smooth and intact, two clustered near the apple and three at the bottom center of the plate | 65
